application_fee.details: The fee must be paid online through Internet Banking or a Debit or Credit Card. Candidates bear the service charges for the payment. Fees paid in Cash, by Cheque, Money Order, Central Recruitment Fee Stamps or Demand Draft are not accepted, and such applications will be rejected. Rs. 400 for UR/OBC and Rs. 250 for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Persons with Disabilities (PWDs), Women, Minorities and Economically Backward Classes will be refunded to eligible candidates who actually appear in the trial. Bank charges are deducted from the refund. In the application, candidates choose whether the refund goes to the account used for payment. If not, they give a beneficiary account: beneficiary name, account number, name of the bank and IFSC code. Candidates seeking a fee exemption as Economically Backward Classes must have Annexure-III filled in and certified by the proper authority. Economically Backward Classes are candidates whose family income is less than Rs 50,000 per annum. Minority candidates must make a self-declaration in the Annexure-V format to claim the fee waiver. They must also furnish a Minority Community declaration affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs.10/-, sworn before an Executive Magistrate. The notice lists the minorities as Muslim/Sikh/Christian/Buddhist/Parsis.

age_limit.details: The age limit for all three levels is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 25 years as on 01.01.2027. The notice prints the date-of-birth range as not earlier than 02.01.2002 and not later than 01.01.2009. No age relaxation (upper or lower) is allowed. Proof of date of birth is a copy of the Matriculation or equivalent certificate from a recognised Board, OR the Birth Certificate, which must be uploaded.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online, between 31 October 2026 and 30 November 2026 (23.59 Hrs). Applications sent directly to RRC will not be entertained.
Visit the RRC-SER website, www.rrcser.co.in, and click the "Online/E-Application for Sports Quota(OA) / 2026-27" link, then "New Registration".

Fill in your personal details: Name, Father's name, Date of Birth, Community, E-mail address and Mobile number. These must match your Matriculation or equivalent certificate. Note the registration number and password sent to you by E-mail/SMS.
Log in with the registration number and password, and complete the registration step by step.
Enter your bank account details for the fee refund, or confirm that the refund should go to the account used for payment.
Enter the details of a valid photo identity card and upload it.

Upload the scanned photograph, signature and LTI, and the self-attested certificates for date of birth, educational/technical qualification, caste (SC/ST/OBC/EBC/EWS), income, OBC and minority self-declarations, and sports achievements.
Pay the fee by credit card, debit card or internet banking.
Submit the application. Note the Unique Registration Number generated at submission, which is needed at later stages.
Take two (02) printouts of the completed application form. No change is allowed after final submission, and the hard copy must be the same as the one submitted online.

Use your own mobile number and a valid, active e-mail ID, and keep them active until recruitment ends. RRC sends all communication only by SMS and E-mail and will not accept requests to change them. For help with the online application, use the Help Line Number and E-mail ID shown on the RRC/SER website.
Photograph: colour, passport size, white/light background, 3.5 cm X 3.5 cm, not older than three months from the date of application. JPG/JPEG, scanned at 100 DPI, up to 70 KB.

The photo must show a clear front view, without cap or sunglasses. If you wear glasses, there must be no glare and the eyes must be clearly visible. It must match your appearance at the trial, document verification and medical test.
The same photo must be used at every stage. The notice advises keeping at least 06 (Six) copies.
Signature and LTI: in black ink on white paper, within a box of 50 mm x 20 mm or 140X60 pixels. JPG/JPEG at 100 dpi, file size 10-40 KB. Both must be the applicant's own.

The signature must be in Hindi or English, not in capital or disjointed letters, and the same at every stage. A different signing style at the trial, document verification or medical examination may lead to cancellation.
A self-attested copy of a valid photo identity card issued by a government body (Aadhar card/PAN card/Driving License/Voter ID Card). Carry this card with the e-call letter at every stage.
A self-attested certificate in proof of educational qualification issued by the Board/Council/University (para 3.5).
Sports achievement certificates only for Championships concluded on or after 01.04.2024, from recognised Sports Association of Indian University.
A self-attested certificate in proof of age (Matriculation/10th certificate).
Self-attested certificates in proof of all recognised sports achievements as per paras 3.2, 3.3 and 3.4.
SC/ST: a self-attested community certificate from the Competent Authority (Annexure-I).
OBC-NCL: a self-attested community certificate (Annexure-II) and a self-declaration that the candidate is not in the Creamy Layer (Annexure-IIA).
EBC: a self-attested Income Certificate from the Competent Authority in the Annexure-III format.
EWS: a self-attested EWS certificate from the Competent Authority (Annexure-IV).
Minority: a declaration for the waiver of examination fees (Annexure-V).
Ex-Servicemen: the discharge certificate and pension documents (copy of PPO).
Certificates in languages other than English or Hindi must come with an attested English/Hindi translation.
Serving employees: a No-Objection Certificate from the employer.

Bring the original documents for date of birth, educational qualification, sports achievements and identification. Without them, you will not be allowed to appear in the selection. Also bring the e-call letter, the original photo identity card used in the online application, and 02 self-attested copies of every document uploaded with the application. You must bring your own kit. No TA/DA or accommodation is given for the trial. You may need to stay 2-3 days and must make your own arrangements. SC/ST candidates are eligible for free second-class rail travel to attend the sports trials.
The notice says applications with any of these defects will be summarily rejected (the list is illustrative, not exhaustive):
Applications sent manually and not registered online.
More than one application registered by the same candidate.
Applications received after the closing date.
No fee paid, or less than the prescribed fee paid.
Incomplete, faulty or ineligible applications.
An undated or unsigned application, or a signature in block, capital or disjointed letters.
No proper scanned photograph, signature and LTI or other enclosures. This includes a black-and-white, capped, sunglassed, disfigured, small, full-body, side-view or unrecognisable photo.
No photo identity card or proper certificates of date of birth, education, sports achievement and caste uploaded. Certificates not from the appropriate authority are liable to rejection.
The candidate lacks the prescribed qualification and minimum sports achievements when applying.
Over age, or date of birth not filled in or wrongly filled in.
A compulsory enclosure is missing, or a column is left blank.
The discipline is not mentioned in the application.
Any other irregularity that RRC/SER considers invalid.
important_instructions: Selected candidates are likely to be posted anywhere on South Eastern Railway after all pre-appointment formalities, including training where prescribed. Selected candidates must submit a Service Bond to serve 5 years with the railway. Candidates appointed to Clerk-cum-typist posts in Group-C must gain typing proficiency of 30 w.p.m. in English or 25 w.p.m. in Hindi within four years of appointment. Until then, the appointment is provisional. Candidates debarred from any RRB/RRC exam need not apply unless their debarment ends by the closing date of this notification. A candidate found ineligible at any stage may be rejected, and one appointed in error is liable to be summarily removed from service. Name, spellings and dates must match the Matriculation certificate. If there is a significant mismatch, the candidature will be cancelled from the day the discrepancy is noticed. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The Railway Administration may fix any date, change the place, or postpone or cancel the trials for unforeseen reasons. No claim will be accepted. Lists of eligible and ineligible candidates, trial dates and venues, and the e-call letter/admit card link will be published on the RRC/SER website. Ineligible candidates will be informed only through the list on the website. South Eastern Railway has not appointed any agent or coaching centre. Report anyone offering selection to the Chairman, Railway Recruitment Cell, South Eastern Railway, Garden Reach, Kolkata-700043, or to the Sr. Dy. General Manager, South Eastern Railway, Garden Reach, Kolkata-700043. The decision of South Eastern Railway in all matters is final. For any legal dispute, the jurisdiction is the Central Administrative Tribunal, Calcutta.

content_sections.heading: RRC SER Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: South Eastern Railway has 54 posts under the Sports Quota for 2026-27: 05 (Five) Group 'C' Level-4/Level-5, 16 (Sixteen) Group 'C' Level-2/Level-3 and 33 (Thirty three) Group 'D' Level-1. Each post is any post of that level in any of the units of South Eastern Railway. For Level-1, the notice refers to Annexure-A of RBE No 79/2026, which is available in the public domain. No post is reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS communities. Candidates with the required performance or achievement in the sports discipline will be selected on overall merit, whatever their community. Candidates may still upload the community they belong to, as required by chapter 13 of the brochure published by the Govt. of India, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievance of Pensions, Deptt. of Personnel Training, New Delhi. For SC/ST/OBC, the caste certificate must be issued by a Competent Authority not below the rank of Tehsildar. OBC candidates must also upload an OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the Central Govt. format, issued not before than 01 year by the competent authority.

Report anyone offering selection to the Chairman, Railway Recruitment Cell, South Eastern Railway, Garden Reach, Kolkata-700043, or to the Sr. Dy. General Manager, South Eastern Railway, Garden Reach, Kolkata-700043. The decision of South Eastern Railway in all matters is final. For any legal dispute, the jurisdiction is the Central Administrative Tribunal, Calcutta.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RRC SER Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 54 posts: 5 in Group 'C' Level-4/Level-5, 16 in Group 'C' Level-2/Level-3 and 33 in Group 'D' Level-1.

faq.question: Q2. When does the RRC SER Sports Quota online application start?
faq.answer: Online applications open on 31 October 2026 on www.rrcser.co.in. The notification was published on the website on 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RRC SER Sports Quota 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026, up to 23.59 Hrs. Applications received after the closing date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for RRC SER Sports Quota 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500 for UR/OBC and Rs. 250 for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Persons, Women, Minorities and Economic Backward Classes, paid online. Rs. 400 (UR/OBC) or Rs. 250 (the others) is refunded to candidates who actually appear in the trial, after deducting bank charges.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RRC SER Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 18 and at most 25 years old as on 01.01.2027. No upper or lower age relaxation is allowed.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for the Level-1 sports quota posts?
faq.answer: Level-1 needs 10th pass or ITI or equivalent or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT, plus the Level-1 sports norms. Level-4/5 needs a University Degree or its equivalent, and Level-2/3 needs class 12th (10+2) or one of the listed matriculation-plus options.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay for RRC SER Sports Quota posts?
faq.answer: All posts are in PB-1 Rs. 5,200-20,200. The Grade Pay is Rs. 2400/2800 for Level-4/5, Rs. 1900/2000 for Level-2/3 and Rs. 1800 for Level-1.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected in RRC SER Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is by sports trials followed by certificate (sports and educational) verification, marked out of 100. The minimum qualifying marks are 70 for Grade Pay 2400/2800, 65 for 1900/2000 and 60 for 1800, with at least 25 out of 40 in the trial.

faq.question: Q9. Are any RRC SER Sports Quota posts reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS?
faq.answer: No. No post is reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS communities, and candidates are selected on overall merit in their sports discipline.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a service bond for RRC SER Sports Quota selection?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must submit a Service Bond to serve 5 years with the railway.
